Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using a Flag-tag (DYKDDDDK) to pull down FKBP51 and its interactors. While the biological study focuses heavily on ubiquitination (K63), the actual MS analysis described in the 'Proteomic analysis' section is a global interactome screen (AP-MS) and not a remnant-peptide enrichment (like diGly/QQTGG) for the MS runs themselves. Labeling is label-free (LFQ) based on the comparison between EV and experimental samples.
